title: 1.1 Map the City
concept: Graph Representation: vertices, edges, vertex degrees, and adjacency lists
objective: Inspect the city escape network to verify its vertices, edges, degrees, and neighbor connections.
controls: Select a junction to inspect its degree and neighbors
start_status: Analyze the 6-junction city network and inspect its adjacency list.
hints: The degree of a vertex in an undirected graph equals the number of incident edges (its neighbor count).
An adjacency list stores, for each vertex, the list of directly connected neighbor vertices.
